supported_checks.label_excerpt: Large painless mass in the right neck
supported_checks.source_quote: referred to Korea University Anam Hospital with a large painless mass in the right neck
supported_checks.explanation: The stated visit motivation is supported.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: The mass was a spindle cell tumor
supported_checks.source_quote: An ultrasound-guided biopsy revealed that the mass was a spindle cell tumor.
supported_checks.explanation: The biopsy result is accurately represented.

findings.label_excerpt: two solid nodules in the right and left lower lobes of the lungs
findings.source_quote: The lung nodules were considered to be possible metastatic lesions.
findings.explanation: The CT result omits the source's material uncertainty that the pulmonary nodules might represent metastases.

findings.source_quote: He was taking medication for hypertension
findings.explanation: The label places an existing medication under treatments without retaining that it was already being taken; this risks presenting historical medication as a treatment initiated during the encounter.

findings.label_excerpt: Totally encapsulated neoplasm with a biphasic pattern composed of predominantly solid dense groups of spindle cells and small quantities of intermixed epithelial components
findings.source_quote: The tumor had a biphasic pattern which was composed of predominantly solid dense groups of spindle cells and small quantities of intermixed epithelial components.
findings.explanation: The label says the neoplasm was totally encapsulated, but this specific histology sentence only states the biphasic pattern. The source does state encapsulation in the preceding sentence, so this is supported by the full note and not an error.

initial.summary: Candidate issues include omission of the stated possible metastatic interpretation of the lung nodules and ambiguity about categorizing pre-existing hypertension medication as treatment. The encapsulation detail is supported elsewhere in the note; it is not a discrepancy.
